titulo: 10:03 a.m.: Coca-Cola CEO pay vs. a median employee's year
caption:
10:03 a.m.: Coca-Cola CEO pay vs. a median employee's year

On paper: reported CEO pay, spread over a 2,080-hour year, matches a median employee's whole year by 10:03 a.m.

Reported CEO total pay, 2024: $28,002,284. Median employee total pay, 2024: $14,144. Both from Coca-Cola's proxy statement (DEF 14A), filed Mar 17, 2025. From a Mar 2025 filing.

The proxy says its median employee comes from the company's global workforce, and that part-time roles, such as certain employees at retail stores operated by Costa Limited, lower the median.

Name a company. We'll run its clock.

Our math: $28,002,284 spread over 2,080 hours is about $13,462 an hour, rounded down. $14,144 is reached at that rate in 1 h 3 min 2 s (the clock shows 10:03 a.m. from a 9:00 a.m. start; minutes are rounded down).

Sources
F1: Coca-Cola proxy statement (DEF 14A), filed Mar 17, 2025 · https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/21344/000155837025003056/ko-20250430xdef14a.htm

Synthetic voice. The quote on screen is copied from the filing. No music.
